description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the ModifySubject command within the Eclipse Ditto policy persistence framework. It processes policies by adding or modifying subjects, generating appropriate events and results based on validation and policy state.

classes.name: ModifySubjectStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a policy command strategy for handling the modification of subjects within policies, encapsulating the logic for applying modifications and generating appropriate events and results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Performs the core logic of applying a ModifySubject command, including validation, event creation, and result generation.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous policy state relevant to the command for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the new policy state after applying the command for concurrency control.
